name: Trellis
description: Persists specs, task PRDs and session journals in your repo and injects them into coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, with plan, implement and check sub-agents.

skills.name: Auto-Injected Specs
skills.description: Injects the relevant conventions from .trellis/spec/ into each agent session so project rules are written once instead of repeated.

skills.name: Task Workflow
skills.description: Keeps PRDs, implementation and review context, and task status in .trellis/tasks/, and archives tasks with /trellis:finish-work.

skills.name: Session Journals
skills.description: Writes per-developer journals in .trellis/workspace/ so each new agent session starts from what happened in the last one.

skills.name: Plan-Implement-Check Loop
skills.description: Runs brainstorm, implement and check sub-agents that write a PRD, code from it, and verify the diff against specs, lint, types and tests.
